verdict.rationale: Devin's docs show it running commands in its own cloud workspace or machine, with a terminal log and per-session environments that boot into a configured known-good state. They also mention macOS virtual machines and reaching package registries from inside the workspace, which implies a separate execution environment where dependencies can be installed. The docs never explicitly describe this workspace as an isolated or secure sandbox, and there is no independent confirmation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox isolation and safety guarantees, explicit dependency-installation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent safely execute code and install dependencies inside an isolated sandbox

citations.quote: Devin’s terminal, where you can watch commands being executed and view output logs.
Devin can build and run Android applications directly on its own machine
Devin can connect to a VPN from inside its workspace, so sessions can reach internal services such as package registries
Configure it once, and every session boots into that known-good state.
Devin now has access to macOS virtual machines.
